candidates.contract_and_trace: The catalog alcohol-specific checks require 1 <= serving_ml <= 10000, ABV <= 10000 basis points, hydration <= serving, valid bools and bounded disinfectant effectiveness. A symbolic 100 ml serving, 5000 basis points, 90 ml hydration, potable true, disinfectant_focused false, effectiveness 0 passes those local numeric and behavior checks. The independently defined properties_valid contract rejects it because physical water is 100*(10000-5000)/10000 = 50 ml. emergency_hydration_ml caps it to 50 ml. The selected typed schema carries fields, the build validator calls validate_capabilities, and item projection and selected reducer/forecast sources carry those properties. The existing source test uses the same impossible values and asserts rejection and a 50 ml cap, but was not executed. This demonstrates only the specified local catalog-check versus helper-contract mismatch, not acceptance of an entire catalog or a live item.
candidates.safeguards_and_limits: The checked-in catalog entries inspected are aqua_vitae (100,5000,0), small_beer (500,300,425), and table_wine (250,1200,150): their hydration does not exceed their computed water. The consuming helper caps excess; no claim of excess water granted. All other admission, authorship, generated or persisted data, data-display, policy and aliases remain open.

bounded_safeguards.finding: For the inspected camp producer, each constructed nonzero morale demand is 15 or 45 ml. Retained supplies have positive integer ethanol per unit. Therefore the inner quantity-decrement loop executes at most the requested 15 or 45 times in total across supplies for one such demand, even if an individual quantity is u32::MAX.
bounded_safeguards.limits: The number of travelers, intervals, distinct demands and scans across supplies is not bounded here. rest_evenings checks a maximum one-year interval individually, not the number of intervals. The public forecast accepts arbitrary u32 requests; no global performance conclusion or product execution.

bounded_safeguards.finding: For alcohol definitions satisfying the inspected catalog numeric checks, serving <= 10000 and each valid basis-point factor <= 10000, so the intermediate product <= 100000000 fits u32. The three checked-in definitions also satisfy this bound.
bounded_safeguards.limits: AlcoholProperties is publicly constructible beyond catalog bounds. For a symbolic 1000000 ml serving at 10000 basis points, saturating multiplication yields 429496 ml rather than the mathematical 1000000 ml. The historical Lens 13 receipt called saturation an explicit normalization policy and left external producers open; do not claim a current incident or contradict its attribution. Decide public input bounds/semantics before any repair.
